'''Swoop sleds''' were [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] which worked best on ice worlds. They were employed by [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zeta Zero Nine]].<ref name="DH">{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}}</ref>
